title: TheFourLeafCollective
description: A modpack made to specialize in four main archetypes, tech, magic, exploration, and building!
body:
# The Four Leaf Collective

This is the official release of a modpack I created for my friends and me. The name reflects the specific design philosophy I followed during development: instead of a basic "kitchen sink" pack with literally everything, I focused on specializing in four main areas, archetypes or "Leaves."

## The Four Leaves:

**Tech: Powered by Create and its various addons.**

**Magic: Centered around Ars Nouveau and its expansions.**

**Building: Featuring the Macaw's series and various tools added to aid the user in building.**

**Exploration: Featuring Terralith, the YUNG's series, and more.**

Feel free to add or remove anything in this modpack for your own playthrough. Remember: this game is meant to be fun, and I won’t judge your personal version of the pack! (especially since i wouldn't be able to see it lol)

Technical Info:

This modpack was developed on a relatively **mid-high-tier** gaming laptop running **CachyOS Linux on PrismLauncher** It is optimized to run on most hardware from the last decade, from high-tier old setups to low-mid-tier modern setups on up.

**There is no plan for a consistent update schedule other than me updating it periodically with stuff when my friends suggest mods**

_**ALL MODS IN THIS MODPACK BELONG TO THEIR ORIGINAL CREATORS AND ARE AVAILABLE ON THIS WEBSITE.**_
